The issuer shows solid profitability (EBIT margin ~15.5% and net margin ~10.7%) and strong liquidity (current assets/current liabilities ~2.5x). Leverage appears moderate (total liabilities ~38% of total assets) with substantial equity (shareholders’ equity of 1,838M), supporting credit strength, though limited coverage and no detailed debt profile constrain the rating from the very highest bands.  

DECISION: A-
